Anna (sales): @Kevin looping you in to scope the POC. We need to confirm data access model, success criteria, and timeline. Can you confirm what data you can provide and any redaction constraints?

Kevin (Acme CTO): Hi — thanks. We'll provide customer support transcripts that contain PHI. We can either: 1) produce a small de-identified/synthetic sample + a mapping doc, or 2) give you a VPC-backed S3 bucket with restricted access. POC timeline: 3 weeks. Success metrics: classification accuracy on intent detection >= 85%, p95 latency < 300ms, and no PHI leakage in outputs.

Devon (solutions): Got it. Two quick clarifying q's: a) If you go S3+VPC, we'll need a cross-account role + VPC endpoint. b) If you send a synthetic CSV, what's the preferred format? We usually accept JSONL with keys: {"conversation_id":..., "turns": [{"role": "user", "text": ...}]}

Priya (security): Quick note from security side: because this is production-ish PHI, we'll need a signed DPA + confirmation of KMS-managed encryption for any stored customer data. Also need the redaction approach documented (regex rules + human review). Please avoid sending raw PHI to public endpoints.

Tara (onboarding): Proposed minimal POC plan: Week 0 - ingest + redaction test (sample 500 rows), Week 1 - run eval prompts + tune, Week 2 - integrate routing + run load test, Week 3 - review + handoff. For evals, suggest 200 labeled examples for intents and 50 generation examples for hallucination checks. Success criteria checklist: [intent_acc >=85%], [p95 latency <300ms], [no PHI in 100% of audited outputs], [cost < $5000 for the POC].

Kevin (Acme CTO): We'll provide synthetic deidentified sample first (500 rows) and will consider setting up a VPC S3 if needed. Can you confirm retention & deletion after POC? Also want verification that logs won't include PII.

Devon (solutions): Retention: we can set the sandbox bucket lifecycle to auto-delete after 30 days (configable). Logs: request traces can be redacted; sensitive fields are removed before logging. Example upload snippet (S3 JSONL):

```
aws s3 cp sample.jsonl s3://acme-poc-input/sample.jsonl 
# sample.jsonl line example
{"conversation_id":"c123","turns":[{"role":"user","text":"Patient: I have chest pain"},{"role":"agent","text":"Have you taken any meds?"}]}
```

And example redaction rule (simple):

```
# redaction pseudo-rule
re.sub(r"\b(Mr|Mrs|Dr)\.\s+[A-Z][a-z]+\b","[NAME_REDACTED]", text)
```

If you prefer cross-account role + VPC endpoint, this is the minimal IAM policy we need: 

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-input","arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-input/*"]}]
}
```

Priya (security): That IAM snippet looks fine as a starting point. For redaction, please also include an audit sample process: we'll manually review 50 outputs; any leakage triggers stop-and-fix. Also ask Acme to share their internal PII/PHI mapping so we can tune rules.

Anna (sales): Pricing note — for a 3-week POC we can offer hosted trial credits to cover generation + eval runs up to $2k. If you need dedicated reserved capacity (predictable p95), we can run a quote for a short-term dedicated pool — that'll be a separate contract. Would you like an estimate for dedicated for just the POC week?

Kevin (Acme CTO): Hosted credits sound good to start. Please send the DPA and I'll have legal sign. Also schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow to walk through the sample format and upload steps.

Tara (onboarding): Scheduled — I created a calendar invite for tomorrow 11am PT. Action items: 1) Kevin to upload synthetic JSONL (500 rows) by EOD tomorrow, 2) Acme legal to sign DPA, 3) Devon to share S3 cross-account steps + short redaction checklist, 4) Priya to provide audit template.

infra-bot: deploy-log: created temporary sandbox bucket: s3://redwood-poc-temp-1806009876 (auto-delete 30d).

Devon (solutions): I'll drop the S3 step-by-step and a redaction sample script in the thread after the call. :thumbsup:

Kevin (Acme CTO): Thanks everyone — will upload sample tonight and confirm legal timeline.
